# Notes by Lex

> A personal knowledge base and software engineering learning hub covering AI, machine learning, and game design through interconnected Zettelkasten notes.

Notes by Lex is maintained by Lex Toumbourou, a software engineer based in Brisbane, Australia with interests in generative AI, machine learning, and game development. The site uses a Zettelkasten note-taking system to organize interconnected knowledge across technical and creative domains.

## Key Topics

- Zettelkasten
- Software Engineering
- Machine Learning
- Generative AI
- Game Design
- Knowledge Base
- Roblox Development
- Kaggle
- Personal Knowledge Management
- Content Organization
- Lex Toumbourou
- Book Reviews
- Navigation & Discovery
- Topic Taxonomy
